recent_calls.summary: The user called to request an estimate for replacing their central AC due to refrigerant loss. The agent collected the user's service address, contact details, and preferred timing for the estimate visit, confirming all information before ending the call. The user requested a callback to confirm the appointment time.

The user called Budget Heating, Cooling & Plumbing after hours to discuss an appointment they were waiting on. The agent informed the user that appointment details could not be confirmed after hours but noted the user's availability for a callback between 9 AM and 11:30 AM the next day. The user provided their phone availability and had no further questions.

The user, Mary, called Budget Heating, Cooling & Plumbing about an issue with her air conditioner and expressed frustration about not knowing the timing of a planned service. The agent explained that it was after hours and that a representative would call her back on the next business day to confirm details.

The user called to inform that they need to reschedule their air conditioner repair appointment due to a conflicting doctor's appointment. The agent offered to notify the team about the rescheduling request and asked for a preferred new date or time. The call ended without the user providing a new date or time.

Mary Brennan called to inquire about rescheduling a technician's visit due to a conflicting eye doctor appointment at 1 PM. She expressed concern about the air conditioner left outside and the timing of the technician's arrival but ultimately decided to keep her appointment and take a chance on the technician's timing. The call ended without a confirmed reschedule.

Mary Brennan called to check the timing of a technician's visit to repair her air conditioner, as she has an eye doctor appointment at 1 PM and wants the technician to come before or after that. The agent was unable to provide a specific arrival time or connect her directly to the technician due to after-hours limitations. The call ended with the user expressing frustration and hanging up.

The user, Lynn, reported an urgent issue with a new air conditioning system failure during extreme heat. The agent collected the user's contact information and service address, documented the issue, and flagged it for priority follow-up since it was after hours. The user was informed that a team member would contact them on the next business day.

The user called to reschedule an appointment from Monday to Tuesday. The agent informed the user that changes cannot be made outside business hours but documented the request for a callback on the next business day. The call ended with no further assistance requested.

Lynn called to request emergency air conditioning repairs for a new unit at 2819 Pennsylvania Avenue, St. Louis. The agent confirmed the details, explained that a technician could not be dispatched immediately due to after-hours, and assured Lynn that the request would be prioritized for the next business day. Lynn confirmed the callback number and had no further requests.
The call was very brief and ended immediately after the agent's initial greeting and request for the service address ZIP code. The user hung up without responding or engaging further.

Lynn called to report a new air conditioning system failure that is an emergency. The agent documented and escalated the issue for follow-up on the next business day, but could not dispatch a technician immediately due to after-hours. Lynn declined any further assistance during the call.

The call was very brief and mostly unintelligible, with the user not clearly communicating their needs. The agent attempted to engage but the conversation did not progress meaningfully before the user hung up.

The user, Lynn, called Budget's after-hours line to report a new system failure. The agent documented the issue and informed Lynn that a representative would contact her on the next business day. The call ended with no further assistance requested.
The call was very brief, with the agent introducing herself and asking how she could assist, but the user hung up immediately without responding.
The call was initiated by the user but ended abruptly after a brief greeting from the agent without any meaningful interaction or assistance provided.
The user, Latoya, returned a missed call and was promptly transferred to a live agent for further assistance. The call was brief and ended with a successful transfer to another agent.
The user requested to speak to a customer service representative, and the agent promptly transferred the call to a live agent. The transfer was completed successfully within a short call duration.
The user requested to speak to a real person, and the agent promptly transferred the call to a live agent. The transfer was successful, and the call ended shortly after.
The user called back after receiving a call from Nicole at the office and was promptly transferred to a live agent for further assistance.

The user called to report a leak under the kitchen sink and requested a service to fix it soon. The agent collected the user's name, ownership status, phone number, and began to confirm the service address. The call ended shortly after without completing the address confirmation.

Michael Summers called to schedule urgent AC service for his unit running nonstop with high indoor temperatures. The agent informed him about the dispatch fee and available appointment slots, but the earliest available times were after the weekend. Michael ultimately decided to cancel the request and disregard his information.

The user called to schedule an appointment for a leak issue and requested to speak with a live agent. The agent attempted to connect the user to a live representative and successfully transferred the call. The conversation was brief but the user's request was addressed.

The user called after receiving a call from the agent's number but the conversation was mostly unintelligible and brief. The agent identified herself and attempted to assist, but the call ended abruptly with the user hanging up.

The user, Tamiko, reported that her air conditioning was not working and it was uncomfortably hot. The agent documented the issue as urgent and informed her that a technician would contact her on the next business day, Monday, since it was before regular hours on a Saturday. The call ended with the user having no further questions.

The user called to report that the work order they received from a technician had the wrong customer's name on it. The agent acknowledged the issue and transferred the call to a live agent for further assistance.

Judy called to report that her air conditioning, which was cleaned last week, has stopped working again and there are medical conditions in the home requiring immediate attention. The agent flagged the request as urgent and informed Judy that the team will contact her on the next business day, which includes Saturday. Judy confirmed no further assistance was needed.

The user called after hours and requested to speak with a live person. The virtual assistant explained that live support was unavailable but offered to take a message for follow-up. The user declined and decided to call back during regular business hours.

The user, Cindy Phipps, scheduled a service appointment for her central air unit that is leaking and not cooling, requesting the earliest possible time on Monday. The agent confirmed her details and informed her that the team would contact her to confirm the appointment. Cindy declined information about maintenance programs and providing feedback.

The user, Sunitha, called after hours requesting estimates for installing a return vent in a bedroom and cleaning a vent at 400 Wild Oak Drive. The agent documented the requests and informed Sunitha that a team member would follow up on the next business day. The call ended with the user declining further assistance.
The call was very brief and disconnected almost immediately after the agent introduced herself. No meaningful conversation took place.

The user, Kim, called to report that their cooling system is not cooling the house properly and there is a possible issue with the fuse box. The agent booked an emergency service appointment for Monday, August 17th at 8 AM. The user declined to provide feedback due to being in a rush.

The call was an automated message from Hazel Woods School District reminding families about upcoming orientation nights at various schools. The user listened to the message and then opted out of future messages by calling the provided number. No further interaction with an agent occurred.

The user, Rondarius Washington, called to check the status of an appointment. The agent was unable to find any appointment under the user's information and offered to leave a message or transfer to a live representative. The user requested a transfer, and the agent successfully transferred the call to a live agent.
The user called to be connected with someone regarding a part delivery. The agent promptly transferred the call to a live agent who could assist further.

The user called to follow up on a callback regarding a part delivery. The agent attempted to assist but then transferred the call to a live agent for further help. The call ended with a successful transfer.

Benjamin called to schedule an AC service under his home warranty as his AC is not cooling. The agent confirmed the details and informed Benjamin that someone from Budget Heating, Cooling & Plumbing would contact him shortly. Benjamin declined information about maintenance programs and feedback requests.
The agent greeted the user and attempted to connect her with a live representative. The call was transferred successfully to another agent for further assistance.

The user called to reschedule an appointment but did not provide a description of the issue despite the agent's request. The call ended without the reschedule being processed due to lack of information.
The user called and was quickly transferred to a live agent for further assistance. The initial agent did not engage in a detailed conversation but facilitated the transfer successfully.

The user, Jeffrey Hirston, called to schedule a standard service appointment for a water heater that is not producing hot water, possibly due to the thermocouple. The agent confirmed the details and informed Jeffrey that no slots were available for the requested day, offering alternative dates instead. The call ended with the agent transferring Jeffrey to a live agent for further assistance.
The user requested to speak with a live person, and the agent promptly initiated a call transfer to a live agent. The transfer was completed successfully within a short call duration.
The user called and requested to speak with a live agent. The initial agent, Sophie, promptly transferred the call to a live agent as requested.
The user called and requested to speak to a specific person, C G. The agent attempted to connect the user and successfully transferred the call to the appropriate number.
The user informed the agent that they were home for the appointment. The agent then proceeded to transfer the call to a live agent for further assistance.

The user called Budget and was initially greeted by an automated agent requesting their service address ZIP code. The user requested to speak to a human, and the call was successfully transferred to a live agent.

The user called to set an appointment for air conditioning service through American Home Shield. The agent collected all necessary details including the property manager's contact and confirmed the information. The user requested to receive information about home maintenance programs via email and provided feedback about initial call difficulties but was satisfied with the service once connected.
The user called to set an appointment and provided their ZIP code. The call ended abruptly after the user requested to set an appointment and said "Hello?" without further interaction.

The user called to request an update on their order. The agent acknowledged the request and assured the user that a human agent would follow up with the latest details. The user did not request any changes or additional information.
